functions.doc: Reserves the slot with the scheduling provider.

Confirms one of the alternative times the slot grid offered. Takes a single alternative rather than the grid, which is what a block that fans out needs: the generated code hands its handler one item at a time.
Looks up availability around the requested time.
Flattens the incoming webhook into the shape the rest of the workflow reads.
Writes the confirmed booking to the app's own database. Separate from placing it, so a failed write is retried without double-booking.

Clears out bookings nobody ever confirmed. Takes no argument, which is what a block on a scheduled run needs: a run the clock starts carries no payload, so a handler that asked for one could never be called.
Texts the customer the open times and asks them to pick one. The reply arrives as a separate event, so this only sends.
